sharedRules.name: Milan Mount
sharedRules.description: A unit with a Transport Attachment with Milan Mount may remove Milan Missile Teams before th game, mounting a Milan Missile on one of the Unit's Transport Teams for each team they removed.

sharedRules.name: Autoloader
sharedRules.description: When a weapon with an Autoloader fires an Artillery Bombardment reduce the score required To Hit Teams under the Template by 1.

sharedRules.name: FR Radar
sharedRules.description: The Twin 30mm AA Gun on an AMX-13 DCA has a range of 36" / 90cm against aircraft and does not suffer the usual +1 to Hit penalty for range over 16" / 40cm when shooting at Aircraft.

sharedRules.name: Gun Slinger
sharedRules.description: A Gun Slinger Helicopter can use Tall Terrain for Concealment, and can remain Gone to Ground while moving. Enemy Anti-Aircraft, Anti-Helicopter and Infantry Weapons shoot at a Gun Slinger Helicopter after it Shoots in its own turn (instead of before when normally shooting at Aircraft).

sharedRules.name: NL Radar
sharedRules.description: The Twin 35mm L/90 Gun on a PRTL has a range of 40" / 100cm against aircraft and does not suffer the usual +1 to Hit penalty for range over 16" / 40cm when shooting at Aircraft.

sharedRules.name: Sneak and Peek
sharedRules.description: A Tank with Sneak and Peek can move 10" / 25cm at Tactical Speed if it is not firing its main gun.
